text: Naomi Fitzwilliam's audit starts with Slither, and it flags claimRewards() with a reentrancy-eth warning -- a real signal, not yet proof.
To confirm it, she writes a malicious attacker contract whose receive() function calls claimRewards() again, and deploys it on a local fork of the live contract.
One external call triggers six nested reentrant claims before the balance ever gets zeroed out.
The entire shared ETH reward pool -- 2.84 ETH owed across every staker -- drains in a single transaction.
Naomi reports it to Desmond and Vivian immediately. Next: the fix, done three ways, not one quick patch.
